svg.aria-label: Headless coordinator worker and UI ownership
svg.text: N: bounded headless and child execution (header design)
Attach / watch process — one client endpoint and checked output owner
Logical client incarnation + immutable command ID; rendered CGR1 cursor is separate from command ACK
Discovery → complete CGV1 replacement / DATA → checked render → CURSOR; GAP never executes effects
One controller reconnect lease; read-only watchers; stdout saturation is explicit client failure
Coordinator process — stable across primary executor handoff
Front door / control core
UI fabric sole receive owner; CGA1 registry
Exact child sessions, intents, copies/local ACK
No route/string/cursor grants execution
Canonical projection / command state
Actual copied CGD1 + control/ASK rows
Atomic CGV1 → existing CGR1 bounded ring
Accepted-command receipt / retired watermark
Local primary / child executor slots
K/L state machine + Q begin/step/end
Provider/config/net/observer/workspace/guard
Exact child borrow; finite depth1 / credits
Orchestrator — worker fabric only
Managed ID ≠ actual socket peer ≠ PID
Kernel provenance + immutable owned child
CGW1 health/shutdown; bounded native reap
Handoff: source frozen checkpoint → target STAGED → exact CAS/guard READY
route publication → ACTIVATE receipt; abort needs fresh explicit epoch, never old-source thaw
Owned worker process (bounded count)
One parent endpoint / static dispatcher
CGW1 native + CGL1 application lanes
Dedicated outbound-only secret bootstrap
No UI role or worker-peer reattachment
Actual primary / child application slots
Owned guarded child tree; no shadow history
Immutable factual tool ledger and result
Cancel drains; parent loss freezes attempts
Resolved profiles pinned per attempt; no resolver
callback, credential env, argv secret or effect replay
Per-app observation bridges outlive net callbacks
Existing G same-host shared store — exact immutable generations + durable owner CAS + independent guard
Source/target use distinct contexts; catalog outlives orchestrator. STARTED before effect; identified result + terminal save before model.
Crash/forced death does not prove descendants stopped: durable uncertainty, explicit recovery, no automatic replay/failover.
Reused completed: Q IPC + core leases • CGA1 local agent lifecycle • CGR1 replay • CGD1 snapshots • G ownership/store
Preserved: J configuration • K/L real client/session safety • R12 two logical generations • typed observation • bounded host output
Draft amendments: IPC provenance/directed send/wipe • core bounded step/session borrow • orchestrator CGW1/managed events • private host modules
No implementation authority until three full passes + different final review; O restores six M exclusions, P retains all38/full release gate.
